working_memory.text: When the Ardvey ferry grounded last autumn the operator's first statement blamed overloading and put the repair bill at 240,000 pounds. The inquiry published this week rejects both figures. It finds the vessel was not overloaded, carrying 61 passengers against a licensed 120, and that the final repair tender came in at 415,000 pounds. The cause it identifies is a chart correction issued eleven months earlier and never applied to the bridge chart in use that night.
